import type { Principal } from "permdock";

let sequence = 0;

/** Restarts the ids and names, so a test reads the same rows on every run. */
export function resetFactories(): void {
  sequence = 0;
}

function next(): number {
  sequence += 1;
  return sequence;
}

function uuid(): string {
  return `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(next()).padStart(12, "0")}`;
}

function text(field: string, min: number, max: number): string {
  return `${field}-${String(next())}`.padEnd(min, "x").slice(0, max);
}

type Ref = string | { readonly id: string };

function idOf(ref: Ref): string {
  return typeof ref === "string" ? ref : ref.id;
}

export type ProjectRow = { readonly id: string; readonly organizationId: string; readonly name: string; readonly status: "active" | "archived"; readonly priority: "low" | "high" | null; readonly budget: number | null; readonly ownerEmail?: string; readonly createdAt: string };

export type TaskItemRow = { readonly id: string; readonly projectId: string; readonly organizationId: string; readonly title: string; readonly done: boolean; readonly tags: readonly (string)[] };

export type FactoryMembership = {
  readonly scope: "organization";
  readonly id: string;
  readonly roles: readonly ("admin" | "member")[];
};

export type FactorySubject = Principal & {
  readonly roles: readonly ("admin" | "member")[];
  readonly memberships: readonly FactoryMembership[];
};
